full_judgment: 4. Common facts relevant for disposal of the Rules are that the opposite party nos.1 and 2 herein as plaintiffs filed Title Suit No.174 of 2005 in the Court of Senior Assistant Judge, Araihajar, Narayangonj, for partition of ejmali property measuring an area of 1.55 acres out of 6.21 acres of the suit land contending interalia that the suit land compromising 10 Plots in C.S. khatian No.36 measuring 5.32 acres and .89 acres of land in C.S. khatian No.441 originally belonged to C.S. recorded tenant Pi Mahmud who died leaving 3 (three ) sons Bochai, All Mahmud and Choly Mahmud and 2 (two) daughters Izzatunnessa and Lazzatunnessa. Bochai was entitled 1.5525 acres land who died leaving son Kolimuddin and daughter Putul Bibi. As the heir of Bochai, Kolimuddin was entitled 1.0350 acres land and died leaving defendant nos.1-5. Putul Bibi died leaving a daughter Pokon Bibi. Pokon Bibi died leaving husband defendant no.11, 3(three) sons defendant nos.6-8, 2(two) daughters defendant nos.9/10. All Mahmud, another son of C.S. recorded tenant Pi Mahmud was entitled 1.5525 acres land in the suit land who died leaving 2(two) sons Rahimuddin and Hazi Ahizuddin, defendant no.18 and 2(two) daughters Shairun and Shanoo. Rahimuddin died leaving 3(three) sons defendant nos.12-14 and 3(three) daughters Fazilatunnessa, Ayesa and Mossamat, defendant nos.15/A. Ayesa died laving a daughter Shahnaz. Shairun, daughter of Ali Mahmud died leaving 2(two) sons defendant nos.19/20 and 3(three) daughters defendant Nos.2 1/22/23. Shanoo, another daughter of Ali Mahmud died leaving 2(two) sons, defendant Nos.24/25 and 4(four) daughters defendant nos.26-29. Cholly Mahmud, another son of Pi Mahmud was entitled 1.5525 acres land in the suit land who died leaving 2(two) sons Taizuddin and Somuruddin and 2(two) daughters Joyrun and Mozirun, defendant nos.46/47. Taizuddin died leaving 2(two) sons defendants nos.30/31 and 5(five) daughters defendant nos.32-36 died leaving wife Khodeza, defendant no.37, son Manu Mia and 2 (two) daughters Minara and Azufa, defendant nos.44/45. Manu Mia died leaving wife Suraiya Begurn, 2(two) sons, defendant Nos.39/40 and 3(three) daughters, defendant nos.41-43. Izzatunnessa, daughter of Pi Mahmud was entitled 771/2 decimals of land and died leaving 3(three) sons Abed Ali, Isab Ali and Nawab Ali. Nawab All died leaving a son Aminuddin. Abed Ali, Isob Ali and Aminuddin, grand son of Nawab Ali, sold 771/2 decimals of land by registered deed no.542 dated 20.01.1987 to the present plaintiffs. Lazzatunnessa, another daughter of Pi Mahmud, died leaving 2(two) sons Pandob All and Sanda Ali. Pandob Ali died leaving a son Latif and Sanda died leaving only son Sukur Mahmud alias Kalai Sukkur Kahmud alias Kalai. Kalai died leaving 3(three) sons, Noor Mohammad Mia, Nurul Haq Mai, Nurul Amin Mia and a daughter Nurzahan. Amongst heirs of Sukkur Mahmud Kalia, 3 (three) sons got the suit land by mutual partition. Abdul Latif Mia, Nur Mohammad Mia, Nurul Haq Mia and Nurul Amin, the heirs of Lazzatunnessa sold the suit land measuring 771/2 decimals land on 08.02.1989 by the registered deed no.1163 to the present plaintiffs. Thus the plaintiffs acquired title in 1.55 acres of land from the suit land and possessed peacefully and uninterruptedly by mutating their names in the khatians and paying rents to the Government exchequer. Defendant nos.1-47 are the owners by way of inheritance and defendant no.55 is the owner by purchase. The plaintiffs and defendants have been occupying the suit land jointly. The plaintiffs demanded partition by metes and bounds and on 29.09.1995 the defendants denied to do so. Hence, the present suit.
